# Host icon artwork (vendored)

Built by `client/scripts/build-host-icons.mjs`; do not edit by hand.

- `logos.ts`: product and vendor marks, from
  [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) 16.38.1 (CC0-1.0), and the
  3 it no longer carries (windows, azure, aws) from
  [Material Design Icons](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/) 7.4.47 (Apache-2.0).
- `glyphs.ts`: generic drawings from Material Design Icons 7.4.47.

One mark is cut down to a single letter of the wordmark (nokia), because the
whole word does not read at icon size.

Both license texts are included. The marks are trademarks of their owners and
are shown only to say what a host runs.
